findings.passage: We need to make voting as accessible as possible for people. We can have elections that are secure while dramatically increasing civic engagement.
findings.note: Issues page on elections; it lists reforms she supports (automatic registration, mail-ballot pre-canvassing, drop boxes) and names no ID requirement.

findings.passage: My legislation will give election officials more flexibility to count ballots faster, expand protections for voters and elections workers, and outline restrictions to safeguard election systems from tampering and unauthorized access.
findings.note: Release announcing an election-law package: mail-ballot pre-canvassing, worker protections, voting machine vendor disclosure, a false-information bill. No ID or citizenship item.

findings.passage: These measures should be implemented for security purposes, not to disenfranchise voters.
findings.note: Her statement after a Senate special committee hearing, about ballot curing and pre-canvassing; she also says she voted against Act 77 over process. No ID topic.
